## My recommendation

If you're starting from scratch, I'd shortlist MailerLite and Brevo first.

- Choose MailerLite if you want something straightforward that looks professional.
- Choose Brevo if you want email marketing alongside a CRM and SMS.

One important consideration for UK businesses: make sure your chosen platform supports your GDPR requirements and that you collect the appropriate marketing consent.
